svg.title: Two independent substitutions, one design principle
svg.desc: The storage matrix has two implementations times two bindings. C1 is independently exercised without cognition using hostile declared-port wrappers. M3 attention replacement uses a separately implemented atomic-file provider; only DTO validation is shared with the SQLite implementation. Four controlled native cases hold exact task/evidence identities, policy, budgets and deadline fixed while selecting the provider in composition. Separate initial-preference cases show the selection effect. Both replacements persist actual state, but the file implementations remain classified fixtures rather than real DeTTa or a production attention service. This demonstrates same-profile replacement on fresh stores, not live migration.
svg.text: Two independent substitutions, one design principle
Select semantics and capabilities explicitly; keep callers independent of provider internals.
Real local DeTTa or an independent
In-process and private stdio bindings pass
SQLite owner or an independent atomic-file
Same STI policy, tasks and budgets;
No shared owner transitions, inheritance or private-table access in the attention
These are fresh-store replacements. Existing accepted state is not migrated.
